title: Stochastic Voronoi Ensembles for Anomaly Detection
Stochastic Voronoi Ensembles for Anomaly Detection
summary: Anomaly detection methods struggle with data exhibiting varying local densities, where distance-based methods miss local anomalies and density-based methods require careful parameter selection and incur quadratic time complexity. SVEAD constructs an ensemble of random Voronoi diagrams by sampling anchors, scores points by normalized cell-relative distance weighted by local scale, and averages scores across partitions. Across 45 ADBench datasets it achieves the highest average AUC-ROC (0.8538) and AUC-PR (0.5000) among 12 baselines, including 0.9339 AUC-ROC on cardio, while maintaining linear time and constant space complexity.

approach: Route is paper_only with no author repository on disk (only an uncloned anonymous.4open.science link), so SVEAD is reimplemented from the paper: for each of t=100 partitions, sample m anchors uniformly without replacement, assign every point to its nearest anchor in standardized feature space (implicit Voronoi, no cell boundaries), score each point as (delta/delta_max) * delta_mean inside its cell, skip singleton cells, and average the per-partition scores. The match target is C1: AUC-ROC 0.9339 on ADBench cardio (1831 samples, 21 features, 176 anomalies); the dataset is fetched at runtime through a validated fallback chain (ADBench GitHub raw -> OpenML cardiotocography -> UCI Cardiotocography), all of which reduce to exactly the same 1831x21 table with 176 positives, and a hard validation gate asserts that shape before any scoring. The m hyperparameter is grid-searched over {2,4,...,256} with 5 seeded repeats per value and t=100, matching the paper's protocol (R7, R8); we report both the label-tuned best m and the full m-curve so the +/-0.0189 tolerance band is interpretable, plus AUC-PR (C2) for free from the same runs. Write svead/svead_core.py: sample_anchors(X, m, rng) -> unique row indices (R1); assign_cells(X, A, chunk_rows) -> (cell_ids, delta) using chunked Euclidean distance and argmin with lowest-index tie-break (R2, R11); cell_stats -> per-cell delta_max and delta_mean computed for all points before any scoring (R4); score_partition -> s = (delta / delta_max) * delta_mean with NaN for singleton cells and a delta_max == 0 guard (R3, R5); svead_score(X, m, t, seed) -> nanmean over t partitions, 0 if all NaN, plus diagnostics (cell-size histogram, skipped fraction, per-partition seconds) (R6, R12).

Write svead/metrics.py: roc_auc_score wrapper, average_precision_score (primary AUC-PR), trapezoidal precision_recall_curve AUC (secondary), and summarize(list) -> mean/std/min/max; all functions take scores first and labels second so labels are consumed only post-prediction (R9, R10).

Run the smoke test: `python experiments/smoke_test.py`. Part A: synthetic 300x6 with 10% Gaussian outliers, m=4, t=3 -> assert finite non-negative scores, shape (300,), AUC-ROC > 0.8. Part B: real cardio, m=8, t=5 -> assert score shape (1831,), deterministic repeat for the same seed, total runtime < 60 s.

Run the pre-full-run intermediate checks below (dataset signature, standardization stats, anchor uniqueness, cell-size/skip diagnostics, a kNN-distance and IsolationForest sanity baseline, single-run timing extrapolation).

Write experiments/run_cardio.py: outer loop over m in the 8-value grid, inner loop over the 5 seeds, each run calling svead_score on the standardized matrix with t=100, recording AUC-ROC, AUC-PR (both variants), wall time, skipped-point fraction and cell statistics; append rows to results/per_m_table.csv and dump raw per-run records to results/raw_cardio.json.

Launch the full suite: `python experiments/run_cardio.py`; after the first two m values finish, check that the extrapolated total stays inside the budget (expected total is only a few minutes because the per-run cost is ~0.1-3 s at these sizes) and only then let it complete.

Select best m = argmax of mean AUC-ROC across the 5 seeds; compute mean/std for AUC-ROC and AUC-PR at that m, and also record the fixed-m=128 (A3 fallback) result and the full m-curve for sensitivity.

Write reproduce.py: load data from cache, reuse or regenerate results/raw_cardio.json, run selection, then write results/metrics.json with (a) C1 value vs 0.9339 with the 0.0189 band and PASS/FAIL verdict, (b) C2 value vs 0.5356, (c) per-m table and per-repeat spreads, (d) dataset provenance and validation flags, (e) timing, (f) the assumption ledger entries applied, (g) an explicit not_reproduced block for C3, C4, C5 and C6 (45-dataset average and GPU/500k scalability are out of scope on CPU).

Run the final entrypoint `python reproduce.py` and read results/metrics.json; report the reproduced C1 with its spread, label the overall verdict partially_reproduced, and never present C3-C6 as reproduced.
smoke_test: `python experiments/smoke_test.py` — synthesizes 300x6 data with 10% outliers at m=4, t=3 and asserts finite non-negative scores, shape (300,), AUC-ROC > 0.8; then scores the full 1831x21 cardio table at m=8, t=5, asserting shape (1831,), reproducible scores for a repeated seed, and under 60 s wall clock. This exercises download -> standardize -> anchor sampling -> nearest-anchor assignment -> cell stats -> scoring -> averaging -> AUC end to end on a few seconds of compute.

Standardization: after StandardScaler, per-column mean ~ 0 (|mean| < 1e-9) and std ~ 1 for all 21 columns; confirm the scaler is fit with no label access.
Anchor sampling: for every m in the grid and every seed, sampled anchor indices are distinct and len == m (requirement R1), verified on 20 random (m, seed) pairs.

Timing probe: time one full run at m=256, t=100 -> extrapolate the whole 40-run grid; if the extrapolation exceeds ~25 minutes, drop to 3 repeats and/or m in {8,16,32,64,128} (documented as a reduced protocol).
Determinism: two back-to-back runs with identical (m, seed) produce bitwise-identical score vectors.

Full cardio grid 25 min reserved though expected ~5-10 min (8 m values x 5 seeds x t=100 on a 1831x21 matrix; each run is only a few seconds, so sum over m of m makes the whole grid roughly 2x the cost of a single m=256 run per seed). Final reproduce.py + metrics.json writing and interpretation 10 min. Contingency: if a run ever exceeds the projection, first cut repeats from 5 to 3, then narrow the m grid to four values, always recording the reduced protocol in results/metrics.json. C3/C4 (45 datasets) and C5/C6 (500k-instance CPU/GPU timing) are deliberately not scheduled.

"""Load, cache and validate the ADBench cardio dataset.

The ADBench cardio benchmark (Han et al., 2022) is the same table as the
UCI Cardiotocography dataset filtered to NSP in {1,3} with label=(NSP==3),
and is distributed as a pre-standardised npz (column mean ~0, std ~1).

Validation gate: asserts X.shape == (1831, 21) and y.sum() == 176.
Labels are returned separately and never touch the scoring code (R10).
"""
import os
import urllib.request

import numpy as np

AD_BENCH_URL = (
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Minqi824/ADBench/main/"
    "adbench/datasets/Classical/6_cardio.npz"
)

EXPECTED_N = 1831
EXPECTED_D = 21
EXPECTED_ANOMALIES = 176


def _cache_dir():
    base = os.environ.get("REPRO_DATA_CACHE")
    if base:
        return base
    return os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)), "data")


def _download(url, dest):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "python"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        data = r.read()
    with open(dest, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
    return len(data)


def load_cardio(cache_path=None):
    """Return (X float64 (1831,21), y int64 (1831,), provenance dict)."""
    if cache_path is None:
        cache_path = os.path.join(_cache_dir(), "cardio.npz")
    provenance = {"source_url": AD_BENCH_URL, "cache_path": cache_path}

    if not os.path.exists(cache_path):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(cache_path), exist_ok=True)
        nbytes = _download(AD_BENCH_URL, cache_path)
        provenance["downloaded_bytes"] = nbytes
    else:
        provenance["loaded_from_cache"] = True

    d = np.load(cache_path)
    X = np.asarray(d["X"], dtype=np.float64)
    y = np.asarray(d["y"]).astype(np.int64).ravel()

    provenance["shape"] = list(X.shape)
    provenance["n_anomalies"] = int(y.sum())
    provenance["anomaly_rate"] = float(y.mean())

    assert X.shape == (EXPECTED_N, EXPECTED_D), f"bad X shape {X.shape}"
    assert int(y.sum()) == EXPECTED_ANOMALIES, f"bad anomaly count {y.sum()}"
    assert not np.isnan(X).any(), "NaN in X"
    assert not np.isinf(X).any(), "Inf in X"
    provenance["validated"] = True
    return X, y, provenance

import time
import numpy as np


def sample_anchors(n, m, rng):
    """Uniform sample of m distinct row indices from range(n) (R1)."""
    return rng.choice(n, size=m, replace=False)


def assign_cells(X, anchors, chunk_rows=8192):
    """Nearest-anchor assignment via chunked Euclidean distances (R2/R11).

    argmin => lowest-index tie-break (A5). No explicit Voronoi cells built.
    Returns (cell_ids int64 (n,), delta float64 (n,)).
    """
    n = X.shape[0]
    cell_ids = np.empty(n, dtype=np.int64)
    delta = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float64)
    a_sq = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", anchors, anchors)
    for start in range(0, n, chunk_rows):
        end = min(start + chunk_rows, n)
        Xb = X[start:end]
        x_sq = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", Xb, Xb)
        d2 = x_sq[:, None] - 2.0 * (Xb @ anchors.T) + a_sq[None, :]
        np.maximum(d2, 0.0, out=d2)
        ids = np.argmin(d2, axis=1)
        cell_ids[start:end] = ids
        delta[start:end] = np.sqrt(d2[np.arange(end - start), ids])
    return cell_ids, delta


def cell_stats(cell_ids, delta, m):
    """Per-cell delta_max and delta_mean over all assigned points (R4)."""
    dmax = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.float64)
    dsum = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.float64)
    count = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.int64)
    np.maximum.at(dmax, cell_ids, delta)
    np.add.at(dsum, cell_ids, delta)
    np.add.at(count, cell_ids, 1)
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        dmean = dsum / np.maximum(count, 1)
    return dmax, dmean, count


def score_partition(cell_ids, delta, dmax, dmean, count):
    """s = (delta/delta_max)*delta_mean (R3). Singleton cells -> NaN (R5)."""
    n = cell_ids.shape[0]
    s = np.full(n, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    c = count[cell_ids]
    dm = dmax[cell_ids]
    dmn = dmean[cell_ids]
    valid = c > 1
    ratio = np.where(dm > 0, delta / np.where(dm > 0, dm, 1.0), 0.0)
    s[valid] = ratio[valid] * dmn[valid]
    return s


def svead_score(X, m, t=100, seed=1, chunk_rows=8192, return_diagnostics=False):
    """Compute SVEAD anomaly scores for X (n,d already standardised).

    Returns scores (n,) float64 = mean over partitions that scored the
    point (R6); all-skipped -> 0 (A7). Diagnostics dict optional.
    """
    X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
    n = X.shape[0]
    m = int(min(m, n))
    score_sum = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
    score_cnt = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    skipped_total = 0
    cell_sizes_all = []
    t0 = time.perf_counter()

    for k in range(t):
        aidx = sample_anchors(n, m, rng)
        anchors = X[aidx]
        cell_ids, delta = assign_cells(X, anchors, chunk_rows=chunk_rows)
        dmax, dmean, count = cell_stats(cell_ids, delta, m)
        s = score_partition(cell_ids, delta, dmax, dmean, count)
        valid = ~np.isnan(s)
        score_sum[valid] += s[valid]
        score_cnt[valid] += 1
        skipped_total += int((~valid).sum())
        cell_sizes_all.append(count[count > 0])

    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0

    final = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
    scored = score_cnt > 0
    final[scored] = score_sum[scored] / score_cnt[scored]

    if return_diagnostics:
        cs = np.concatenate(cell_sizes_all) if cell_sizes_all else np.array([0])
        return final, {
            "elapsed_sec": elapsed,
            "skipped_fraction": skipped_total / float(t * n),
            "n_partitions": t,
            "m": m,
            "mean_nonempty_cells": float(cs.size) / t,
            "max_cell_size": int(cs.max()),
            "mean_cell_size": float(cs.mean()),
            "min_cell_size": int(cs.min()),
        }
    return final

"""Evaluation metrics. Called only after scores are produced (R9/R10).

Labels are consumed solely here, post-prediction, preserving the
unsupervised protocol.
"""
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import (
    average_precision_score,
    precision_recall_curve,
    roc_auc_score,
)


def roc_auc(scores, labels):
    """AUC-ROC via sklearn (R9). scores first, labels second (R10)."""
    return float(roc_auc_score(labels, scores))


def auc_pr(scores, labels):
    """AUC-PR. Primary: average_precision (ADBench convention, R9).

    Returns (ap, trapezoidal_pr_auc).
    """
    ap = float(average_precision_score(labels, scores))
    prec, rec, _ = precision_recall_curve(labels, scores)
    # precision_recall_curve returns increasing recall; trapezoid over recall
    order = np.argsort(rec)
    trap = float(np.trapezoid(prec[order], rec[order]))
    return ap, trap


def summarize(values):
    """mean/std/min/max over a list of run values."""
    v = np.asarray(list(values), dtype=np.float64)
    return {
        "mean": float(v.mean()),
        "std": float(v.std(ddof=0)),
        "min": float(v.min()),
        "max": float(v.max()),
        "n": int(v.size),
    }

"""Intermediate checks before the full grid run."""
import os
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from svead import load_cardio, svead_score, roc_auc
from svead.svead_core import sample_anchors, assign_cells, cell_stats

X, y, prov = load_cardio()
print("== Dataset signature ==")
print("shape", X.shape, "anoms", int(y.sum()), "rate", round(float(y.mean()), 4))
assert X.shape == (1831, 21) and int(y.sum()) == 176

print("\n== Standardization (ADBench artifact) ==")
cm = X.mean(axis=0)
cs = X.std(axis=0)
print("max |col mean|", float(np.abs(cm).max()))
print("col std range", float(cs.min()), float(cs.max()))
assert np.abs(cm).max() < 1e-6
assert cs.min() > 0.99 and cs.max() < 1.01

print("\n== Anchor uniqueness (R1) ==")
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
for _ in range(20):
    m = int(rng.choice([2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]))
    aidx = sample_anchors(X.shape[0], m, rng)
    assert len(np.unique(aidx)) == m
print("20 random (m,seed) anchor sets all unique: OK")

print("\n== Cell diagnostics m=256 ==")
s, diag = svead_score(X, m=256, t=100, seed=1, return_diagnostics=True)
for k, v in diag.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")
assert diag["skipped_fraction"] < 0.005, diag["skipped_fraction"]

print("\n== delta_mean > 0 for non-singleton cells ==")
rr = np.random.default_rng(5)
aidx = sample_anchors(X.shape[0], 256, rr)
cid, dl = assign_cells(X, X[aidx])
dmax, dmean, count = cell_stats(cid, dl, 256)
nonsingleton = count > 1
assert np.all(dmean[nonsingleton] > 0), "delta_mean not > 0"
print("delta_mean>0 for all non-singleton cells: OK")

print("\n== Determinism ==")
a = svead_score(X, m=64, t=10, seed=2)
b = svead_score(X, m=64, t=10, seed=2)
assert np.array_equal(a, b)
print("bitwise identical: OK")

print("\n== Sanity baselines ==")
ifo = IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, random_state=1)
ifo.fit(X)
if_auc = roc_auc(-ifo.score_samples(X), y)
print(f"IsolationForest AUC-ROC = {if_auc:.4f}")
nn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=6).fit(X)
dist, _ = nn.kneighbors(X)
knn_auc = roc_auc(dist[:, 1:].mean(axis=1), y)
print(f"kNN mean-dist AUC-ROC = {knn_auc:.4f}")

print("\n== Timing probe m=256 t=100 ==")
t0 = time.perf_counter()
_ = svead_score(X, m=256, t=100, seed=1)
one = time.perf_counter() - t0
print(f"one run m=256 t=100 = {one:.3f}s")
est_grid = one * (510.0 / 256.0) * 5
print(f"extrapolated full grid (8 m x 5 seeds) ~ {est_grid:.1f}s")
print("\nALL INTERMEDIATE CHECKS PASSED")

"""Full cardio protocol: m-grid x 5 seeds at t=100 (R7, R8, R9, R10).

Writes results/raw_cardio.json and results/per_m_table.csv.
"""
import csv
import json
import os
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from svead import load_cardio, svead_score, roc_auc, auc_pr, summarize

M_GRID = [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]
SEEDS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
T = 100

RESULTS = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "results")
os.makedirs(RESULTS, exist_ok=True)


def main():
    X, y, prov = load_cardio()
    records = []
    for m in M_GRID:
        for seed in SEEDS:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            scores, diag = svead_score(X, m=m, t=T, seed=seed, return_diagnostics=True)
            wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
            aroc = roc_auc(scores, y)
            ap, trap = auc_pr(scores, y)
            rec = {
                "m": m, "seed": seed, "t": T,
                "auc_roc": aroc, "auc_pr_ap": ap, "auc_pr_trap": trap,
                "wall_sec": wall,
                "skipped_fraction": diag["skipped_fraction"],
                "mean_nonempty_cells": diag["mean_nonempty_cells"],
                "max_cell_size": diag["max_cell_size"],
            }
            records.append(rec)
            print(f"m={m:>3} seed={seed} AUC-ROC={aroc:.4f} AUC-PR={ap:.4f} "
                  f"wall={wall:.2f}s skip={diag['skipped_fraction']:.4f}")

    per_m = {}
    for m in M_GRID:
        sub = [r for r in records if r["m"] == m]
        per_m[m] = {
            "auc_roc": summarize([r["auc_roc"] for r in sub]),
            "auc_pr_ap": summarize([r["auc_pr_ap"] for r in sub]),
            "auc_pr_trap": summarize([r["auc_pr_trap"] for r in sub]),
        }

    best_m = max(M_GRID, key=lambda mm: per_m[mm]["auc_roc"]["mean"])

    out = {
        "config": {"m_grid": M_GRID, "seeds": SEEDS, "t": T},
        "best_m_by_mean_auc_roc": best_m,
        "per_m": {str(m): per_m[m] for m in M_GRID},
        "records": records,
        "dataset": prov,
    }
    with open(os.path.join(RESULTS, "raw_cardio.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2)

    with open(os.path.join(RESULTS, "per_m_table.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["m", "auc_roc_mean", "auc_roc_std", "auc_pr_mean", "auc_pr_std"])
        for m in M_GRID:
            w.writerow([m,
                        round(per_m[m]["auc_roc"]["mean"], 4),
                        round(per_m[m]["auc_roc"]["std"], 4),
                        round(per_m[m]["auc_pr_ap"]["mean"], 4),
                        round(per_m[m]["auc_pr_ap"]["std"], 4)])

    print("\n=== Per-m summary (5 seeds) ===")
    print(f"{'m':>5} {'ROC mean':>9} {'ROC std':>8} {'PR mean':>8} {'PR std':>8}")
    for m in M_GRID:
        a = per_m[m]["auc_roc"]; p = per_m[m]["auc_pr_ap"]
        print(f"{m:>5} {a['mean']:>9.4f} {a['std']:>8.4f} {p['mean']:>8.4f} {p['std']:>8.4f}")
    print(f"\nBest m by mean AUC-ROC = {best_m}")
    print(f"Best-m AUC-ROC = {per_m[best_m]['auc_roc']['mean']:.4f} "
          f"+/- {per_m[best_m]['auc_roc']['std']:.4f}")
    print(f"Best-m AUC-PR  = {per_m[best_m]['auc_pr_ap']['mean']:.4f} "
          f"+/- {per_m[best_m]['auc_pr_ap']['std']:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
